core_obligations: Degree zero: prove injectivity from the definition of restriction, then surjectivity by gluing local lifts, using the covering-lifting lemma to shrink the covering so that the lifts agree on the intersections (proof lines 2866-2880).
Reduce positive degrees to injective sheaves by dimension shifting, so that it suffices to show that the cohomology of the restriction of an injective to Z vanishes (proof lines 2883-2886).

Rewrite a Cech class of a covering of Z as coming from the presheaf of sections of the injective that extend to X, and refine the covering so that each cocycle value is such a section (proof lines 2887-2912).

Lift the cocycles to sections over opens of X using flasqueness of the injective, then shrink the covering so that the lifted cochain is a cocycle over an open neighbourhood of Z, and conclude that the class is a coboundary by the triviality of the higher Cech cohomology of an injective (proof lines 2914-2947).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to injectives and to a Cech class on Z (proof lines 2883-2891).
The presheaf of extendable sections and the refinement (proof lines 2897-2912).
Lifting by flasqueness and shrinking to a cocycle (proof lines 2914-2947).
difficulty_reason: For a topological space X and a quasi-compact subset Z whose points admit disjoint open neighbourhoods, the lemma shows that the canonical map from the colimit of the cohomology over the open neighbourhoods of Z to the cohomology of the restriction of a sheaf to Z is an isomorphism (statement lines 2847-2863). The proof is long and has genuine content. Degree zero is handled by hand: injectivity is immediate, and surjectivity requires gluing local lifts, for which the author finds opens W_ij inside the pairwise intersections on which two lifts agree and then applies a covering-lifting lemma for quasi-compact Hausdorff subsets to shrink the U_i so that the lifts glue (proof lines 2866-2880). For positive degrees the argument reduces to injective sheaves, then rewrites a Cech class of a covering of Z as a class of the presheaf of sections that extend to X, refines the covering so that every cocycle is such a section, lifts the cocycles to X using flasqueness of injectives, and finally shrinks the covering so that the lifted cochain becomes a cocycle, at which point triviality of the higher Cech cohomology of an injective finishes the proof (proof lines 2883-2947). The claim is H3: the presheaf of extendable sections, the refinement producing cocycles of that presheaf, and the two shrinkage steps using the covering-lifting lemma are an original assembly, not a citation chain.
